tasks.name: fix-tool-args
tasks.prompt:
Fix issue #435: show meaningful tool arguments in the progress display.

In `crates/claudes/src/output.rs`, find the `extract_tool_arg` function. Currently it takes the first value from the tool's input object, which for Grep might be a numeric parameter like head_limit instead of the pattern.

Replace the 'grab first value' logic with a preferred-argument map for known tools:
- Read, Edit, Write: use `file_path`
- Grep: use `pattern`
- Glob: use `pattern`
- Bash: use `command`
- WebSearch: use `query`
- WebFetch: use `url`
- For unknown tools, fall back to the first string-typed value (skip numeric values)

The function signature stays the same: `fn extract_tool_arg(block: &serde_json::Value) -> String`

Also update the tool name extraction in `render_progress` to pass the tool name to `extract_tool_arg` so it can use the preferred-arg map. Change signature to `fn extract_tool_arg(tool_name: &str, block: &serde_json::Value) -> String`.

Update the call site in `render_progress` and `render_ndjson` (if it calls extract_tool_arg).

Only modify: `crates/claudes/src/output.rs`

tasks.name: fix-hook-display
tasks.prompt:
Fix issue #434: show hook execution in the progress display.

Two changes needed:

1. In `crates/claudes/src/runner.rs`, emit events when hooks start and complete:
   - Before running each hook, send a `claudes_hook_start` event with task name, hook kind (pre/post/finally), and command
   - After each hook completes, send a `claudes_hook_complete` event with exit code and duration_ms
   - Use the existing event_sender pattern (check if sender exists)

2. In `crates/claudes/src/output.rs`, handle the new events in `render_progress`:
   - On `claudes_hook_start`: update the task's spinner message to show the hook, e.g. `post_hook: cargo test --lib`
   - On `claudes_hook_complete`: no visual change needed (the next event will update the spinner)

3. In `render_ndjson`: pass through the hook events with task name injected (same pattern as other claudes events)

Only modify:
- `crates/claudes/src/runner.rs`
- `crates/claudes/src/output.rs`

tasks.name: review-and-pr
tasks.prompt:
Review the changes from fix-tool-args and fix-hook-display, then commit and create a PR.

1. Read the modified files (output.rs, runner.rs) and verify:
   - extract_tool_arg uses preferred arguments per tool
   - Hook events are emitted in runner.rs
   - Hook events are handled in progress and ndjson renderers
   - No clippy warnings, code is formatted

2. Run the full check:
   - cargo fmt --all -- --check
   - cargo clippy -p claudes --all-targets -- -D warnings
   - cargo test --lib -p claudes

3. Fix any issues found.

4. Commit with message: feat(claudes): hook progress display and meaningful tool args (#434, #435)

5. Create PR:
   gh pr create --title 'feat(claudes): hook progress display and meaningful tool args (#434, #435)' --body '## Summary
- Show hook execution in progress spinner (e.g. post_hook: cargo test)
- Show meaningful tool arguments (Grep shows pattern, not line count)
- Hook events in ndjson output for machine consumption

Closes #434, closes #435

## Test plan
- [ ] cargo test --lib -p claudes
- [ ] Manual: progress display shows hook names and correct tool args'

Do NOT merge the PR.
